page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Top: a verse block of ten lines ending with a signature line "P. J. H. J. B. P." followed by a rule. Then a dedication heading, a title, a sub-title, and a body of verse in one column, ending with "Et" at the lower right. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: Vir Docte, quæ brevi libro complecteris
Non passus es latere Lectorem tuum.
Faxit Deus, ne solidiora quæ doces
P. J. H. J. B. P.
Scripta quæ nobis dedisti, Docte Vir, quidni
colam, Æstimemque quovis auri cariora pondere?
Quid lupinis æra distent, quid Superficiariâ
Hæc sacrum mentita nomen Veritatis nos
quidem Glandibus diu repavit, quotquot ad Scientias
plurimos Improbo videas labore cuncta (si Diis placet) Et

page.notes: Scan is a faint, skewed print; some letters uncertain, notably in "Litterasque" and "Mathesseos", which read as printed. The verse ends mid-line at the page foot.
